# The White Witch™

> Three doors lead: The White Witch, Mira's World, and Emoji Games. LibreSky is second, in two editions, with SociallyDead beside them. MAGIC and RETRO MAGIC each have a shelf. Blogy, MAGIC Dock, Cinder, and Vesper are native Qt. MAGIC Dock runs on Linux. Mail: thewhitewitchtm@google.com.

No accounts on this site. The work is linked below.

## Doors

- [The White Witch](https://thewhitewitchtm.github.io/whitewitch/): politics, tools, and the long pages. Facts first.
- [Mira's World](https://thewhitewitchtm.github.io/mira/): tools, projects, tutorials, and the dev blog.
- [Emoji Games](https://thewhitewitchtm.github.io/emojigames/)

## LibreSky

- [LibreSky](https://thewhitewitchtm.github.io/LibreSky/): Bluesky client in the browser. Edit, AI, voice, video, and chat. Opens directly.
- [LibreSky source](https://github.com/TheWhiteWitchTM/LibreSky)
- [LibreSky Corporate](https://thewhitewitchtm.github.io/corporate/): the edition you host. Small enough for a Pi. Coming soon. The banner says LibreSky Corporate.
- [SociallyDead](https://thewhitewitchtm.github.io/sociallydead/): a directory of social media. Websites, YouTube, X, and Bluesky.

## MAGIC

Lua and BASIC, compiled to JavaScript. The emoji games needed a language. This is that language.

- [MAGIC](https://thewhitewitchtm.github.io/whitewitch/magic/)
- [MAGIC Studio](https://thewhitewitchtm.github.io/whitewitch/magic/studio/)
- [MAGIC Apprentice](https://thewhitewitchtm.github.io/whitewitch/magic/apprentice/)
- [Card on this site](https://thewhitewitchtm.github.io/magic/)
- [Source](https://github.com/TheWhiteWitchTM/MAGIC)

## RETRO MAGIC

The same language, pointed at the C64, the Apple II, and the TI-99/4A.

- [RETRO MAGIC](https://thewhitewitchtm.github.io/whitewitch/magic/retro/)
- [RETRO Studio](https://thewhitewitchtm.github.io/whitewitch/magic/retro/studio/)
- [RETRO Toolchain](https://thewhitewitchtm.github.io/whitewitch/magic/retro/toolchain/)
- [RETRO Center](https://thewhitewitchtm.github.io/retro-center/): a shelf for the C64, the Apple II, the TI-99/4A, the Amiga, and the Atari ST.

## Native Qt

- [Blogy](https://thewhitewitchtm.github.io/blogy/): Markdown editor. Preview, front matter, publish with git.
- [MAGIC Dock](https://thewhitewitchtm.github.io/magic-dock/): a dock for Pop!_OS COSMIC. Linux only. Stacks.
- [Cinder](https://thewhitewitchtm.github.io/cinder/): an editor for bash and sh.
- [Vesper](https://thewhitewitchtm.github.io/vesper/): music and video for the quiet hours.

## Also

- [FAUX NEWS](https://thewhitewitchtm.github.io/faux-news/): satire. The right-wing wires, with a joke filed beside the headline they ran. The desk itself is [here](https://thewhitewitchtm.github.io/FauxNews-/).
